arms.C: Stitch compression: Stitch proposals + Stitch leaf-cost utility
arms.D: hybrid: Stitch proposals + DreamCoder MDL selection
arms.O: oracle library (true active latents) + prior fit, no compression
arms.O_uniform: oracle library, uniform weights, no learning
arms.D_wake10000: hybrid: Stitch proposals + DreamCoder MDL selection
arms.PW_C: Stitch compression: Stitch proposals + Stitch leaf-cost utility
arms.PW_D: hybrid: Stitch proposals + DreamCoder MDL selection

arm_notes.PW_*: compressor applied to the ground-truth programs of all training tasks (perfect exposure)
arm_notes.PWS_*: compressor applied to the ground-truth programs of training tasks with depth <= 4
